name: MUSES05
type: Two-chip J-FET input audio op-amp, single, DFN12-CA8
tagline: MUSES flagship: a two-chip JFET single on an oxygen-free copper frame, rated among the most resolving on Head-Fi.

lineage.note: Mass production announced 2021-06-23 (EN 2021-07-02). Customer-only at first; 2021-12-01 announced general sale from 2022-02.
NJR–Ricoh merger successor. Sale notice 2022-12-19; open sale about 2022-12. Suspended, reported discontinued 2024-06, now restarted.

part_numbers.note: DFN12-CA8 (ESON12-CA8), OFC frame, no DIP. JA page: restarted; EN page: TBA.
Tape-and-reel code at Mouser, DigiKey, element14, Microchip USA, Ovaga, Xecor; stock unverified.
Two MUSES05 on a dual adapter; only a promo item from the 2021-12-01 campaign.

reputation.summary: Billed by NJR/Nisshinbo as the best-sounding MUSES. PHILE WEB praised its staging and 3D depth. A Head-Fi roller found it about twice as fast as MUSES03, with more resolution, air and reverb but less vocal body, ranking it with the Burson V7 Vivid. Japanese DIY blogs use it widely; one could not tell it from MUSES03D. No independent measurements found.
typical_uses: Headphone amplifiers (e.g. KORG HA-K, T.b.sound builds)
Rolling via DIP8 modules or DUO dual adapters
caveats: SMD-only DFN12-CA8: rolling needs a DIP8 module; results depend on the adapter.
Single: a dual socket needs two parts on an adapter such as MUSES05 DUO.
5.8 mA supply current matters in battery gear.
Supply intermittent: customer-only 2021, open sale ~2022-12, suspended, then restarted; resellers list it 廃版.
Praise is subjective; headline specs nearly match MUSES03 (new_western_elec comparison, 2022-12).

counterfeit_notes: No MUSES05 fakes reported; DFN is harder to fake than DIP. Risk: converted or dual modules resold on Yahoo Auctions, Yahoo Flea Market, Mercari as 廃版. Buy from Mouser, DigiKey, element14 or Akizuki (g117512, g117650, g117651); check marking, date code.

silicon_changes.identification: No documented way: no PCN, no datasheet after Ver.1.0, no new suffix or marking. DFN date code is a plausible but unverified clue.
silicon_changes.summary: Production halted (by 2024-06 at the latest) because production materials were hard to obtain; the EN page says it resumes as MUSES05 after material adjustments. new_western_elec reportedly says a process material, not part of the chip. Die, attach, mould or OFC frame impact is undisclosed. Only known process risk.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown. No listening comparison or measurement of pre- and post-restart lots found.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same part number, package and datasheet Ver.1.0; no before/after spec table or PCN.
silicon_changes.verification: JA page says resumed; EN page says timing TBA. Sale from 2022-02 per PR Times. No PCN or restart date.
